simple.summary: יַצִּיב (yatstsîyb) means fixed , sure ; concretely, certainty First listed occurrence: Dan 2 8.

definitions.full: H3330. yatstsiyb יַצִיב adjective certain, true ( ᵑ7 id., firm, native (= אֶוְרָת )); — absolute ׳י Dan 2:8 , 45 , emphatic בָא - 3:24 (K § 59.g ); feminine singular בָא - 6:13 7:16 ; — 1 certain, sure Dan 2:45 ; in exclamation 3:24 undoubtedly! מִןיַֿצִּיב 3:8 of a surety. 2 TRUE Dan 6:13 ; feminine as substantive 7:16 the truth concerning, עַל of thing.
